name: Monash University FODMAP Diet App
terms: Monash laboratory-tested the foods in this database and licenses access through their app. Bucketing their measured values into low/moderate/high would reduce their precision without changing where the values came from, so this site does not restate them. Entries citing Monash link out instead.

name: SIGHI Food Compatibility List for Histamine Intolerance
terms: Widely used by patients and published by the Swiss Interest Group Histamine Intolerance under their own terms. Listed here because readers will encounter it, and linked rather than reproduced.

name: Low-Histamine Diets: Is the Exclusion of Foods Justified by Their Histamine Content? (Nutrients, 2021)
terms: Peer-reviewed publication. This site characterises its findings categorically and cites it; it does not reproduce its tables.

name: Biogenic amines in foods: histamine and food processing (Inflammation Research, 1999)
terms: Peer-reviewed publication, cited and characterised rather than reproduced.

name: Estimation of the oxalate content of foods and daily oxalate intake (Kidney International, 2000)
terms: Peer-reviewed publication, cited and characterised rather than reproduced.

name: Effect of different cooking methods on vegetable oxalate content (J. Agricultural and Food Chemistry, 2005)
terms: Peer-reviewed publication, cited and characterised rather than reproduced. Reports values for prepared rather than raw vegetables, which is why it sometimes disagrees with raw-food tables.

name: Salicylates in foods (J. American Dietetic Association, 1985)
terms: Peer-reviewed publication and the origin of most published salicylate food lists. Cited and characterised rather than reproduced; note its age when weighing it.

name: A systematic review of salicylates in foods: estimated daily intake of a Scottish population (Molecular Nutrition & Food Research, 2011)
terms: Peer-reviewed publication, cited and characterised rather than reproduced.
